title: Register each Papyrus site through reviewed configuration
description:
As a Papyrus site operator, I want my site registered with Prospectus so its server can ask about accounts after sign-in.

Feature: Register each Papyrus site through reviewed configuration
  Scenario: A reviewed site registration
    Given a site's server role, Google-only Cognito issuer, app client and reviewed federation policy
    When the site is added as one reviewed configuration entry and deployed
    Then only that role can call Prospectus as that site and the API access policy admits it
    And the site may read the person's account directory to answer Cyclotron Lab access

  Scenario: More sites than the current limit
    Given more than 20 registered sites
    When the registry loads
    Then registrations remain exact and unambiguous without a fixed 20-entry cap

Ryan chose reviewed configuration over a runtime admin API on 2026-10-17. Adding a site should be a one-line change. Sites in other AWS accounts need the central API access policy to admit their role.
